Ethics, Professional Responsibilities an: Communication with management and those charged with governance
Assessing Risk and Developing a Planned: Understanding an entity and its environment
Understanding an entity’s control environment and business processes, including information technology (IT) systems
Assessing and responding to risks of material misstatement, whether due to fraud or error
Planning for and using the work of others
Performing Further Procedures and Obtain: Procedures to obtain sufficient appropriate evidence
Specific matters that require special consideration
Subsequent events and subsequently discovered facts

exam_mode.note: The real AUD exam is 4 hours: 78 multiple-choice questions in two testlets, then 7 task-based simulations; each part is half the score. Exam mode gives the multiple-choice part half the time.
